business_problem: ServiceNow’s post-sales teams were working with fragmented data and disconnected processes, making it difficult to spot churn risk, prove value, and coordinate renewals across the customer lifecycle.
solution_summary: ServiceNow’s post-sales teams were working with fragmented data and disconnected processes, making it difficult to spot churn risk, prove value, and coordinate renewals across the customer lifecycle. ServiceNow implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, Workflow Data Fabric, RaptorDB, and CRM. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Workflow Data Fabric connects operational data and automation context; RaptorDB accelerates workflow analytics; CRM contributes account and opportunity context. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, and uses context from RaptorDB and CRM before ServiceNow AI Platform and Workflow Data Fabric routes or fulfills the work. Updates then flow back to agents, account teams, or customers through the same connected experience. Running post-sales and revenue operations on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.
